rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policy (and disables FORCE/RLS) on northstar_learning.anonymous_progress, then drops the anonymous_progress table. The table holds anonymous, device/session-scoped learning progress that is merged into the authenticated progress table on sign-in; on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place; the authenticated progress table and all other 000016 learning tables are untouched.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: row-level security is enabled and forced on northstar_learning.anonymous_progress with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: GATE-LEARNING-GA UX-010 closer: anonymous device/session progress merged into the authenticated account on sign-in (furthest-wins, idempotent, tenant-scoped)
